subject: math
question:
设 $f(x) \in C^{(2)}[a, b]$ ，证明 $\exists \xi \in (a, b)$ ，使

$$
\int_ {a} ^ {b} f (x) \mathrm{d} x = f \left(\frac {a + b}{2}\right) (b - a) + \frac {1}{2 4} f ^ {\prime \prime} (\xi) (b - a) ^ {3}.
$$
answer: $$ \int_ {a} ^ {b} f (x) \mathrm{d} x = f \left(\frac {a + b}{2}\right) (b - a) + \frac {1}{2 4} f ^ {\prime \prime} (\xi) (b - a) ^ {3}. $$

steps.text:
分析 由等式右边的形式可看出应将 $f(x)$ 在点 $x_0 = \frac{a + b}{2}$ 处展开为一阶泰勒公式，再做积分即可.

将 $f(x)$ 在点 $x_0 = \frac{a + b}{2}$ 处展开为一阶泰勒公式.

$$
f (x) = f \left(\frac {a + b}{2}\right) + f ^ {\prime} \left(\frac {a + b}{2}\right) \left(x - \frac {a + b}{2}\right) + \frac {1}{2 !} f ^ {\prime \prime} (\eta) \left(x - \frac {a + b}{2}\right) ^ {2}
$$

(其中 $\eta$ 在x与 $\frac{a+b}{2}$ 之间).

积分得

$$
\int_ {a} ^ {b} f (x) \mathrm{d} x = f \left(\frac {a + b}{2}\right) (b - a) + \frac {1}{2} \int_ {a} ^ {b} f ^ {\prime \prime} (\eta) \left(x - \frac {a + b}{2}\right) ^ {2} \mathrm{d} x.
$$

由积分第一中值定理，知 $\exists \xi \in (a,b)$ ，使

$$
\int_ {a} ^ {b} f ^ {\prime \prime} (\eta) \left(x - \frac {a + b}{2}\right) ^ {2} d x = f ^ {\prime \prime} (\xi) \int_ {a} ^ {b} \left(x - \frac {a + b}{2}\right) ^ {2} d x = f ^ {\prime \prime} (\xi) \frac {1}{1 2} (b - a) ^ {3}.
$$

所以

$$
\int_ {a} ^ {b} f (x) \mathrm{d} x = f \left(\frac {a + b}{2}\right) (b - a) + \frac {1}{2 4} f ^ {\prime \prime} (\xi) (b - a) ^ {3}.
$$

solution.final_answer: $$ \int_ {a} ^ {b} f (x) \mathrm{d} x = f \left(\frac {a + b}{2}\right) (b - a) + \frac {1}{2 4} f ^ {\prime \prime} (\xi) (b - a) ^ {3}. $$
